digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate + Gerrit DET criterion + orchestrator routing
propositions: Explicit review-plan on a bug ticket with non-test file_impact must escalate from light advisory tier to full blocking rubric at BOTH enforcement seams: precheck det_blocking lift and route_criteria tier selection, covering batch-runner fan-in identically, while maintaining claim-time exemption and defaulting to light tier for test-only or undeclared impact.

Gerrit DET code-review criterion must block bug-fix commits exceeding 150 non-test lines lacking a current or code-drifted plan-review attestation, with a teaching remediation message directing authors to declare blast radius and re-review.

Plan-review attestation verification for B2 must read cross-host via opcert_from_record, trusted_env keyring lookup by record principal, and opcert.verify_opcert—never via own-env plan_review_status—then apply compute_validity for freshness, accepting certified/stale-code/stale-head verdicts.

Non-test classification must exclude tests/** and conftest.py from line count, with a single shared constant threshold (150 lines) consumed by both Gerrit criterion and backtest script, and tested against historical corpus for exact set equality with 13 adjudicated-substantive commits and zero false positives.

Attestation verdict predicate must accept {certified, stale-code, stale-head}, flag remaining plan-review-reachable compute_validity literals and cross-host op-cert failures {mismatch, key_not_valid_at_era, unknown_kind, unknown_scheme, invalid}, and fail open (advisory only) on {unavailable, error, unknown-future}.
Debug-skill Phase-1-exit hook must invoke review-plan for non-trivial fixes, coordinating with writeback anchors landed in child ticket 78f1.
